Own site says the 151 N Broadway building is closed after flooding and a small number of cats are temporarily housed at St. Paul's UMC, 341 Wilson Ave, Green Bay (visits Fri 12-6, Sat-Sun 12-4, $3 entry, half-hour slots); The Pawffee Shop in Appleton is described as its rescue partner, but the program page could not be opened, so cafe status is unverified.
